studies.independence: Four nested regions of one regional study; not four independent studies. Habitat-use models pool bird locations into used/available shore-points and use region random effect.
studies.design: Six paired binomial logit GLMMs for breeding/nonbreeding, day/night, and daytime high/low tides, each with four habitat covariates; not a joint tide-by-diel behavior model.
studies.tide_definition: Highest vs lowest 50% of station/week predicted tide heights; 15 tidal stations.
studies.diel_definition: Sunrise to sunset; thesis figure captions describe civil sunrise/sunset.
effort_cautions: Satellite tag duty cycle 1 h on/48 h off if solar charge adequate.
Raw records biased toward summer/daylight. Reduced data retain four fixes/bird/week with 3:1 day:night ratio, favor highest Argos class.
Tide habitat comparison restricted to daytime locations.
Argos errors <250m to1500m; habitat use is not directly observed feeding or activity.
The 17,954 and 2,681 records belong to19 birds; habitat selection excludes another Pacific Rim bird to use18.
studies.test_locator: Article Results3.2, Fig4; thesis Fig2.4/2.5 pp39–40. Figure has standardized habitat coefficients with CI, not numeric table.
studies.exclusion_reason: Only z and p text; coefficients/CI graphical. Predictor is habitat characteristic within temporal strata, not diel or tide odds of activity. Separate significant and nonsignificant tests do not establish stratum interaction.

raw_data.action: No credentials, license acceptance, contact or request action taken.

studies.location: Humble Island / Palmer Deep, western Antarctic Peninsula
studies.sample_size_warning: Methods says103 location-tracked birds, but Table1 annual bird entries sum113; uniqueness/repeated deployments cannot be resolved from article. Do not claim113 independent birds.
studies.tide_predictor: Weekly switching between one-high-tide/day and two-high-tides/day regimes; not solar day versus night.
studies.effect_units: km distance from colony, with mixed model trip random effect
studies.effect_contrast_uncertainty: No contrastSE or covariance extracted; group-mean SEs must not be combined as independent. All-location models fit log10 distance, so reported km summaries are not a direct coefficient scale.
studies.locator: Results Analysis of2011 Penguin Diving Locations, equations1–2; Analysis of2002–2011 Penguin Locations; Table1
studies.raw_data_availability: No original timestamp data repository verified; only supporting track image S1 linked in article.
studies.value: Mechanistic contextual evidence and daily-tide null; longer tidal-regime effect in one colony.

studies.location: San Lorenzo colony, Peninsula Valdes, Argentina
studies.ecology: Brooding adult central-place forager in strong reversing cross-currents.

raw_original_observation_source.type: 1Hz processed original biologging observations; not all original40Hz sensor channels
raw_original_observation_source.potential_reanalysis: Per-bird exposure-aware dive/surface activity using Timestamp, ID, Behaviour, depth and coordinates. Astronomical solar elevation can be computed. Tidal-current phase/strength needs a separate join of Ocean_Currents.csv; no prejoined current fields verified. Account for trip progression, repeated1Hz measurements and one-trip/bird sampling.
raw_original_observation_source.metadata_header_caution: Repository description lists more variables than actual CSV. Verified header has10 columns. Currents, prey pursuit, trip_status and Hour are absent; current information must be joined from separate ocean data/workflow.

ocean_data.description: ROMS vertically averaged U/V currents; hourly240 hours from2019-11-22; eight principal tidal forcing constituents plus harmonics.
